1.web: Now these are the nations which Yahweh left, to prove Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
1.asv: Now these are the nations which Jehovah left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

2.web: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing of it:
2.asv: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as beforetime knew nothing thereof:

3.web: the five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.
3.asv: namely, the five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baal-hermon unto the entrance of Hamath.

4.web: They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the commandments of Yahweh, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.
4.asv: And they were left, to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of Jehovah, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.

5.web: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
5.asv: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

6.web: and they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.
6.asv: and they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.

7.web: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the sight of Yahweh, and forgot Yahweh their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.
7.asv: And the children of Israel did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and forgat Jehovah their God, and served the Baalim and the Asheroth.

8.web: Therefore Yahweh’s anger was kindled against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.
8.asv: Therefore the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Cushan-rishathaim eight years.

9.web: When the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
9.asv: And when the children of Israel cried unto Jehovah, Jehovah raised up a saviour to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

10.web: The Spirit of Yahweh came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Yahweh delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand: and his hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.
10.asv: And the Spirit of Jehovah came upon him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Jehovah delivered Cushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand: and his hand prevailed against Cushan-rishathaim.

11.web: The land had rest forty years. Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
11.asv: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

12.web: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the sight of Yahweh: and Yahweh strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in the sight of Yahweh.
12.asv: And the children of Israel again did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah: and Jehovah strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah.

13.web: He gathered to him the children of Ammon and Amalek; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.
13.asv: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek; and he went and smote Israel, and they possessed the city of palm-trees.

14.web: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
14.asv: And the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

15.web: But when the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised them up a savior, Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a man left-handed. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.
15.asv: But when the children of Israel cried unto Jehovah, Jehovah raised them up a saviour, Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a man left-handed. And the children of Israel sent tribute by him unto Eglon the king of Moab.

16.web: Ehud made him a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.
16.asv: And Ehud made him a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he girded it under his raiment upon his right thigh.

17.web: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab: now Eglon was a very fat man.
17.asv: And he offered the tribute unto Eglon king of Moab: now Eglon was a very fat man.

18.web: When he had made an end of offering the tribute, he sent away the people who bore the tribute.
18.asv: And when he had made an end of offering the tribute, he sent away the people that bare the tribute.

19.web: But he himself turned back from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret errand to you, king.” The king said, “Keep silence!” All who stood by him went out from him.
19.asv: But he himself turned back from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king. And he said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.

20.web: Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.
20.asv: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.

21.web: Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body:
21.asv: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body:

22.web: and the handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.
22.asv: and the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, for he drew not the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.

23.web: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.
23.asv: Then Ehud went forth into the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room upon him, and locked them.

24.web: Now when he was gone out, his servants came; and they saw, and behold, the doors of the upper room were locked; and they said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”
24.asv: Now when he was gone out, his servants came; and they saw, and, behold, the doors of the upper room were locked; and they said, Surely he is covering his feet in the upper chamber.

25.web: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room: therefore they took the key, and opened them, and behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.
25.asv: And they tarried till they were ashamed; and, behold, he opened not the doors of the upper room: therefore they took the key, and opened them; and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.

26.web: Ehud escaped while they waited, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped to Seirah.
26.asv: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirah.

27.web: When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he before them.
27.asv: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the hill-country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill-country, and he before them.

28.web: He said to them, “Follow me; for Yahweh has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.
28.asv: And he said unto them, Follow after me; for Jehovah hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and suffered not a man to pass over.

29.web: They struck of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, every lusty man, and every man of valor; and there escaped not a man.
29.asv: And they smote of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, every lusty man, and every man of valor; and there escaped not a man.

30.web: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. The land had rest eighty years.
30.asv: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.

31.web: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also saved Israel.
31.asv: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who smote of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox-goad: and he also saved Israel.
